name: confluence-sync
description: Git-like pull/push/status sync between local Markdown notes (Obsidian vault) and Confluence Cloud pages, plus one-pass creation of a whole page/folder tree from a spec. Supports version messages, optimistic-locking conflict detection, Jira smart links, PlantUML and Mermaid diagrams, Confluence user mentions, note frontmatter mirroring (including live page version) and folder name sync.
